headline_marked: 3 killed in [[shooting at In-N-Out Burger]] in Idaho, US
headline: 3 killed in shooting at In-N-Out Burger in Idaho, US
summary: At least two others were injured and are in critical condition after a gunman entered the restaurant's dining area on Saturday.
details: At least three people were killed and two others were injured in a shooting at an In-N-Out Burger restaurant in Idaho, USA, according to Reuters.
The incident occurred around 2:30 PM local time on Saturday, August 1.
Police reported that the gunman entered the dining area with a weapon and opened fire. The suspect is also reported to be dead.
Authorities have not clarified if the suspect is included in the total death toll of three, nor how the suspect died.
The Twin Falls Police Department closed nearby roads and a bridge for security reasons during the operation.
Idaho Senator Mike Crapo and other state representatives expressed their condolences and praised the rapid response of emergency services.
The shooting took place in Twin Falls, a city with a population of approximately 47,400 in the Magic Valley region of Idaho.
caption:
A peaceful Saturday afternoon turned tragic as a gunman opened fire inside an In-N-Out Burger in Idaho.

At least three people were killed and two others were injured in a shooting at an In-N-Out Burger restaurant in Idaho, USA, according to Reuters.

The incident occurred around 2:30 PM local time on Saturday, August 1.

Police reported that the gunman entered the dining area with a weapon and opened fire. The suspect is also reported to be dead.

Authorities have not clarified if the suspect is included in the total death toll of three, nor how the suspect died.

The Twin Falls Police Department closed nearby roads and a bridge for security reasons during the operation.

Idaho Senator Mike Crapo and other state representatives expressed their condolences and praised the rapid response of emergency services.

The shooting took place in Twin Falls, a city with a population of approximately 47,400 in the Magic Valley region of Idaho.

Source: Jamuna TV
